taskRouting.title: AI task assignments
taskRouting.description: Choose the actual AI source for each task. A selected key never switches provider after an error.
taskRouting.loadError: Unable to load or save AI tasks.
taskRouting.saveError: Unable to save this task assignment.
taskRouting.autoStatus: First compatible active key by priority
taskRouting.lookupPromptScope: Only affects Deep analysis. Choose its provider and model in the assignment above.
taskRouting.keyUnreadableHelp: The server cannot decrypt this key. Re-add it under API Keys, then assign it again.

runtimeReasons.schema-unavailable: API key storage is not ready
runtimeReasons.vault-unavailable: Encrypted key storage is not ready
runtimeReasons.credential-unreadable: Stored key cannot be decrypted; re-add it
runtimeReasons.capability-unavailable: No compatible key for this task
runtimeReasons.assigned-key-unavailable: Assigned key is no longer active

conversationReply.title: Chat reply
conversationReply.when: When you send a message in AI Conversation.
conversationReply.data: Persona, relationship, summary, recent messages, and active memories.
conversationReply.output: One conversation reply with hidden reasoning removed.
conversationReply.storage: Transcript and receipt in the conversation.

lookupQuick.title: Quick lookup
lookupQuick.when: When dictionary/cache data is insufficient or SRS needs a basic meaning.
lookupQuick.data: The selected word or phrase, not the whole lesson.
lookupQuick.output: Pinyin, concise meaning, and basic vocabulary fields.
lookupQuick.storage: Transient AI result; personal data only after Save.

lookupDeep.title: Deep analysis
lookupDeep.when: For detailed word/sentence analysis, editor context, or vocabulary generation.
lookupDeep.data: Selected word/sentence, selected context, and compatible expert prompt if set.
lookupDeep.output: Structured analysis validated for the requesting surface.

dailyReadingTranslation.title: Daily Reading · Translation
dailyReadingTranslation.when: When the translation module is enabled for a sourced article.
dailyReadingTranslation.storage: This device's browser with a receipt.

dailyReadingVocabulary.title: Daily Reading · Vocabulary
dailyReadingVocabulary.when: When the vocabulary module is enabled.
dailyReadingVocabulary.output: A vocabulary list matching the configured count.
dailyReadingVocabulary.storage: This device's browser with a receipt.

dailyReadingGrammar.title: Daily Reading · Grammar
dailyReadingGrammar.when: When the grammar module is enabled.
dailyReadingGrammar.output: Grammar points matching the configured count.
dailyReadingGrammar.storage: This device's browser with a receipt.

dailyReadingQuestions.title: Daily Reading · Questions
dailyReadingQuestions.storage: This device's browser with a receipt.

conversationSummary.title: Conversation summary
conversationSummary.when: After turns when the thread context needs compaction.
conversationSummary.data: Thread messages covered by the summary.

conversationMemoryExtraction.title: Memory extraction
conversationMemoryExtraction.when: When the post-turn memory pipeline runs.
conversationMemoryExtraction.storage: Account long-term memory after policy checks.

conversationSemanticMemory.title: Semantic memory
conversationSemanticMemory.when: When memory embeddings are created or searched.
conversationSemanticMemory.data: The memory text or retrieval query to embed.
conversationSemanticMemory.output: An embedding vector; lexical fallback remains available.
conversationSemanticMemory.storage: Server-side memory embedding, not a new transcript.

activity.title: AI activity
activity.description: 90-day metadata only; no prompts, lookup text, transcripts, outputs, or raw provider errors.
